_about: Building blocks a product can need, each with a portable choice that runs anywhere, the native managed service on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, and a local stand-in for running a service standalone. devops uses it for docs/03d-portability.md; validate_portability.py checks block names against it. Service names change: confirm current names and prices with the vendor's own tools (AWS MCP Server, Azure MCP Server / Azure Skills plugin, Google Cloud MCP servers) or pricing calculators before quoting a client. Reviewed Oct 2026.

containers.need: run services as containers without managing servers

kubernetes.need: many services, fine-grained scheduling, an existing Kubernetes skill set

functions.need: short event-driven jobs that scale to zero
functions.portable: the handler as a plain function behind an adapter (run as a normal process locally)
functions.local: the same handler run as a process

relational-db.aws: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
relational-db.azure: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server

document-db.need: flexible documents, very high key-value throughput

queue.need: work handed from one service to another, retried until done

events.need: one service announces something, any number react
events.azure: Azure Event Grid (or Service Bus topics)

streaming.gcp: Google Cloud Managed Service for Apache Kafka (or Pub/Sub)

secrets.need: keys, passwords and connection strings outside the code
secrets.portable: a secrets interface; values injected at deploy time
secrets.local: .env file never committed (or OpenBao dev server)

identity.portable: OpenID Connect (Keycloak or a SaaS identity provider)

api-gateway.need: one public entry point, routing, rate limits, auth at the edge

observability.aws: Amazon CloudWatch + AWS X-Ray (via the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry)
observability.gcp: Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace

scheduler.azure: Azure Container Apps jobs (or Functions timer trigger)

email.gcp: no first-party service: a SendGrid/Mailgun account via an adapter

search.gcp: Vertex AI Search (or Elastic Cloud on Google Cloud)

cdn-static.need: static front end and assets close to users
cdn-static.azure: Azure Front Door + Blob Storage static website

iac.need: the infrastructure itself, reviewable and repeatable
iac.aws: Terraform AWS provider (CloudFormation/CDK if the client mandates)
iac.azure: Terraform azurerm provider (Bicep if the client mandates)
iac.gcp: Terraform google provider (Infrastructure Manager runs Terraform)

pricing_sources.aws: AWS Pricing Calculator, or the AWS MCP Server (AWS Price List API)
pricing_sources.azure: Azure Pricing Calculator, or the Azure MCP Server pricing tools
pricing_sources.gcp: Google Cloud Pricing Calculator, or the Cloud Billing Catalog API

vendor_agent_tools.aws: AWS MCP Server (managed; any AWS API through one tool; AWS agent skills; IAM, CloudTrail)
vendor_agent_tools.azure: Azure Skills plugin (Azure skills + Azure MCP Server + Foundry MCP Server)
vendor_agent_tools.gcp: Google Cloud MCP servers (managed, remote, IAM-controlled; per-product toolsets)
vendor_agent_tools.terraform: HashiCorp Terraform MCP server (registry providers, modules, policies)
